description: Repo scaffold, shared vocabulary, backend config/database/main, ORM models, Pydantic schemas, auth router (register/login/me/PATCH me), rate limiting, decoy generator, seed script, and duress tests. This is the data-layer and auth foundation everything else builds on.
steps: 1. Create directory tree. Run from /Users/zamadangwana/Mukuru-Detection: mkdir -p backend/{engine,decoy,model,routers,schemas,models,tests} web data scripts docs i18n. Add backend/model/.gitkeep, backend/tests/.gitkeep.

2. Create backend/requirements.txt with these pinned packages (use these exact versions or newer compatible ones):
fastapi==0.115.0
uvicorn[standard]==0.30.6
sqlalchemy==2.0.36
pydantic==2.9.2
pydantic-settings==2.5.2
bcrypt==4.2.0
slowapi==0.1.9
scikit-learn==1.5.2
langdetect==1.0.9
pytest==8.3.3
httpx==0.27.2
python-multipart==0.0.12
passlib[bcrypt]==1.7.4

Also create backend/.env.example with all env vars from docs/api_contract.md (DATABASE_URL, SECRET_KEY, MOCK_SAFE_BROWSING, SAFE_BROWSING_API_KEY, LLM_ENABLED, LLM_API_KEY, LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_MODEL, RULES_WEIGHT, CLASSIFIER_WEIGHT, CORS_ORIGINS) with safe default values.

3. Create backend/config.py — a Pydantic BaseSettings class named Settings that reads all env vars with typed fields and sensible defaults. DATABASE_URL defaults to 'sqlite:///./mukuru.db'. Include a module-level singleton: settings = Settings(). No FastAPI imports.

4. Create backend/database.py — SQLAlchemy engine created from settings.DATABASE_URL using create_engine with connect_args={'check_same_thread': False} for SQLite. DeclarativeBase subclass named Base. SessionLocal = sessionmaker. get_db() generator dependency. init_db() function that calls Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine). All paths via settings, which uses absolute path from os.path.abspath.

5. Create backend/models/__init__.py (imports all models so Base.metadata is fully populated). Create backend/models/user.py — User model (id=UUID PK auto-generated, phone=String(20) unique, pin_hash=String(128), duress_pin_hash=String(128), country=String(2), language=String(5) default 'en', trusted_contact=String(20) nullable, is_in_duress=Boolean default False, login_guard_alert_until=DateTime nullable, created_at=DateTime default utcnow). UserSession model (id=UUID PK, user_id=FK→users.id, token=String(64) unique indexed, is_duress=Boolean default False, expires_at=DateTime, created_at=DateTime).

6. Create backend/models/scan.py — ScanResult (id=UUID PK, user_id=FK→users.id nullable, text_hash=String(64), channel=String(10), score=Integer, tier=String(10), category=String(30), reasons=JSON, advice=JSON, explanation_source=String(10) default 'rules', detected_language=String(5), created_at=DateTime). Create backend/models/transaction.py — Transaction (id=UUID PK, user_id=FK→users.id, recipient=String(50), amount=Numeric(12,2), currency=String(3), country=String(2), status=String(15) default 'completed', is_decoy=Boolean default False, direction=String(10) default 'sent', created_at=DateTime). Create backend/models/sms.py — SMSMessage (id=UUID PK, user_id=FK→users.id nullable, direction=String(10), body=Text, sender=String(50), created_at=DateTime). Create backend/models/audit.py — AuditLog (id=UUID PK, user_id=FK→users.id nullable, event_type=String(50), detail=JSON, created_at=DateTime).

7. Create backend/schemas/common.py — ErrorResponse(error:str, message:str, field:str|None=None), SuccessResponse(status:str='ok'). Create backend/schemas/auth.py — RegisterRequest (phone:str validated E.164 regex, country:str 2-char, language:str one of 8 codes, pin:str 4 digits, duress_pin:str 4 digits, trusted_contact:str|None=None; model_validator confirms pin != duress_pin), LoginRequest (phone:str, pin:str), UserOut (id:str, phone:str, country:str, language:str, created_at:datetime), LoginResponse (token:str, user:UserOut), AccountResponse (id:str, phone:str, country:str, language:str, balance:str, currency:str, recent_transactions:list, created_at:datetime), PatchAccountRequest (language:str validated against 8 codes). Create backend/schemas/scan.py — ScanRequest (text:str max_length=10000, channel:Literal['web','ussd','sms','email'], user_id:str|None=None), ScanResponse (id:str, score:int, tier:str, category:str, reasons:list[str], advice:list[str], explanation:str, explanation_source:str, detected_language:str, scanned_at:datetime). Create backend/schemas/transaction.py — TransactionCheckRequest (recipient:str, amount:Decimal, currency:str, country:str), TransactionCheckResponse (score:int, tier:str, reasons:list[str], advice:list[str], checked_at:datetime), SendRequest (recipient:str, amount:Decimal, currency:str, country:str, force:bool=False), SendResponse (transaction_id:str, status:str, amount:str, currency:str, recipient:str, sent_at:datetime). Create backend/schemas/sms.py — SmsInboundRequest (from_number:str aliased 'from', body:str, timestamp:datetime|None=None), SmsInboundResponse (status:str, reply:str), SmsMessage (id:str, direction:str, sender:str, body:str, created_at:datetime), SmsOutboxResponse (messages:list[SmsMessage], total:int, limit:int, offset:int).

8. Create backend/routers/auth.py. Implement POST /register: validate phone uniqueness (409 if taken), reject if pin==duress_pin (400), hash both PINs with bcrypt (rounds=12 via passlib), default language from country_language_defaults in reason_codes.json if not provided, create User, create UserSession, return 201 LoginResponse. Implement POST /login: fetch user by phone; use secrets.compare_digest on BOTH pin_hash and duress_pin_hash regardless of which matches (check both always, pick first match) — this is the constant-time requirement; if normal match, is_duress=False; if duress match, is_duress=True; write AuditLog(event_type='duress_login') if duress; create UserSession; return LoginResponse (IDENTICAL shape for both paths). Implement GET /accounts/me: get current user from bearer token; if session.is_duress call generate_decoy_account; else return real data with balance='0.00' (MVP has no real balance tracking) and recent_transactions from DB. Implement PATCH /accounts/me: update user.language, return {language: ...}. Implement get_current_user() dependency that reads Authorization header, looks up token in UserSession, returns (user, session) tuple.

9. Create backend/routers/stub stubs for all remaining routers: scan.py (POST /scan stub returning mock), transactions.py (POST /transactions/check, POST /transactions/send, GET /transactions/history stubs), ussd.py (POST /ussd stub), sms.py (POST /sms/inbound, GET /sms/outbox stubs), panic.py (POST /panic stub), login_guard.py (POST /login-guard/event stub), library.py (GET /scams/library stub). Each stub returns a contract-shaped response. These will be replaced in later FEATs.

10. Create backend/main.py — FastAPI app with title 'Mukuru Detection', version '1.0.0'. Add CORSMiddleware with allow_origins from settings.CORS_ORIGINS. Add slowapi Limiter (key_func=get_remote_address), attach to app state and exception handler. Lifespan context manager that calls init_db() on startup. Mount all routers with correct prefixes. POST /login gets rate-limit decorator 5/5minute.

11. Create backend/decoy/generator.py. generate_decoy_account(user_id: str) -> dict: seed=hash(user_id) & 0xFFFFFFFF; rng=random.Random(seed); generate 8-15 plausible transactions over past 120 days (amounts R20-R200, recipients from ['Mom','Grocery','Airtime','School fees','Transport','Water & Lights','Church','Rent']); return dict matching AccountResponse shape with balance='0.00', currency='ZAR', recent_transactions list. Each transaction has id (deterministic UUID from seed), recipient, amount (str formatted '%.2f'), currency, direction (mostly 'sent', 20% 'received'), created_at (deterministic datetime). No FastAPI imports.

12. Create backend/seed.py. Use os.path to construct absolute path to DB. Call init_db(). Idempotent: check if +27831234567 already exists before inserting. Create Blessing (+27831234567, country=ZA, language=zu, pin=1234, duress_pin=9999, trusted_contact=+27821234567). Create Tendai (+263771234567, country=ZW, language=en, pin=1234, duress_pin=9999). For Blessing: 12 Transaction rows spread over past 90 days (ZAR, small amounts to Mom/Grocery/Airtime, status=completed). One ScanResult row created_at=now()-10min, tier=HIGH_RISK, category=fake_job_offer, score=85, reasons=['FAKE_JOB_OFFER','ASKS_FOR_MONEY','MOVE_TO_WHATSAPP'], advice=['DO_NOT_PAY_UPFRONT','VERIFY_SENDER','REPORT_SCAM'], text_hash=sha256('demo_fake_job_seed'), channel='sms'. For Tendai: 10 Transaction rows (USD, remittances to Zimbabwe recipients). For both: one SMSMessage outbox row (direction=outbound, sender=MukuruAlert, body='Scam of the Week: Watch out for fake job offers asking for R500 registration fees. Real jobs never ask for upfront payment. Stay safe!'). Create backend/tests/__init__.py.

13. Create i18n/zu.json — complete isiZulu translation with EVERY key from i18n/en.json. Include _meta with lang=zu, name=isiZulu, status=complete. All tier/reason/advice/ussd/sms/ui keys translated. Create i18n/fr.json, i18n/sw.json, i18n/st.json, i18n/hi.json, i18n/nl.json, i18n/pt.json — each containing all keys from en.json (with translations where straightforward, English fallback where uncertain) plus _meta.status='draft, needs native review'. i18n/hi.json must include a _romanized key next to every ussd.* and sms.* key (e.g. 'ussd.welcome_romanized': 'Mukuru Detection mein aapka swagat hai').

14. Create backend/tests/test_duress.py using pytest and httpx TestClient. Tests: (a) POST /login with normal pin and POST /login with duress_pin return identical JSON keys (sorted); (b) GET /accounts/me with duress session returns balance='0.00'; (c) decoy recent_transactions contains no real transaction IDs (none match real DB rows); (d) AuditLog has a duress_login row after duress login. All tests use a fresh in-memory SQLite DB (override DATABASE_URL to 'sqlite:///:memory:' via fixture). Create conftest.py in backend/tests/ with a pytest fixture that creates the test FastAPI app with an in-memory DB and a test httpx client.
acceptance_criteria: uvicorn backend.main:app --reload starts without import errors
POST /register returns 201 with token and user fields
POST /login with normal pin and duress pin return identical JSON key sets
GET /accounts/me with duress session returns balance='0.00'
python backend/seed.py runs without error and is idempotent (safe to run twice)
All 8 i18n/*.json files exist and contain the same keys as i18n/en.json
verification: python backend/seed.py && python backend/seed.py  (run twice to verify idempotency)
uvicorn backend.main:app --reload  (confirm starts on :8000 with no errors)
